dia_chi_raw: Toa One Mount, T26, Times city
mo_ta_cong_viec:
One Mount is Vietnam's largest technological ecosystem that creates solutions along the entire value chain, starting with retail, distribution, real estate, and financial services. Our mission is to build Vietnam's most trusted ecosystem, empowering all people and businesses to realize their full potential at the intersection of technology and humanity.
We are looking for an innovative and experienced Hands-on Solution /Technical Principal to lead the design and implementation of scalable, resilient, and secure architectures for our fintech platforms. This role plays a key part in shaping the technical vision and system blueprint for digital financial services. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that architecture decisions align with business goals, technological capabilities, and long-term scalability.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Design, build, and maintain high-throughput, resilient, and event-driven distributed systems (Microservices, Kafka/RabbitMQ).
Guide dev teams in identifying technical debt, code refactoring, and optimizing complex database queries (PostgreSQL, MongoDB).
Partner with data engineers to bridge application architecture with scalable data pipelines; drive automated CI/CD and Cloud infrastructure (GKE, Docker, Kubernetes).
Champion observability, low-latency execution, clean code, and Domain-Driven Design (DDD) methodologies.
yeu_cau:
Experience: 7+ years in Software Engineering & Architecture, with a strong background as a Senior Developer / Technical Lead / Architect role.
Core Tech Stack: Deep expertise in Enterprise Java (Spring Boot / WebFlux) and designing low-latency, high-availability systems.
System & Database Design: Hands-on experience with Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture, relational DB tuning (PostgreSQL/MySQL), and NoSQL.
Cloud & DevOps: Strong knowledge of GCP/AWS, Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/GKE), and modern CI/CD pipelines.
Problem-Solving: Strong technical communication—ability to simplify complex technical trade-offs for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
